source: data/amirnet-vocab.csv, Tier 1 (A2) — the 234 headwords still missing from the bank, i.e. every Tier-1 row not already covered by an existing batch-*.jsonl. This batch completes Tier 1 (1,243/1,243 headwords now present).
selection_rule: every Tier-1 headword absent from the bank, in CSV order (alphabetical within the tier, per data/amirnet-vocab.csv).
word_only_note: T-353 (checked live in plan/50-tasks.md before this batch: ✅ C-0800) landed the schema/build:ingest/measure-gate support for sentence-less rows. Per Roy 14/09: "he doesn't have to write loads of sentences for every word — he raises the number of words and drops the sentences." Every row here carries only headword · pos · translation_he · cefr_level (plus he_one_to_many_group/he_interference_note where it cost nothing) — examples/items/distractors are all null/empty by design, NOT a gate failure. Exercises for these words are deferred to a future targeted tick, per the same instruction.
translation_confidence_note: 2 of 234 rows are translation_confidence:"low" ("shall" — no one-word Hebrew equivalent for the future-tense auxiliary; "pence" — collides in spelling with the unrelated Hebrew word פני). Every other row is "high" or "medium"; medium is used where the headword is genuinely polysemous and one dominant A2 sense was chosen (e.g. "being" as a noun, "single" as unmarried, "speaker" as a person) — the alternate sense is named in he_one_to_many_group/he_interference_note where the collision is with another word already plausible in the bank.
n_syllables_note: n_syllables is a heuristic vowel-group count (script: build-tier1-batch.mjs, kept outside the repo), not hand-checked per word — a soft signal, not gated by gateSense.
batch_size_note: 234 rows — the entire remaining Tier-1 (A2) gap, chosen because Roy's 14/09 volume instruction plus T-353 landing removes the sentence-writing cost that used to cap batches at ~25-50 words; well under the 1,200-row-per-file ceiling. Sized to finish Tier 1 cleanly as one unit rather than leave a partial span.
next_marker: Tier 1 (A2) is now fully covered (1,243/1,243). The next tick should move to Tier 2 (B1), per STEP 4's ordering, starting from data/amirnet-vocab.csv tier==2 in CSV order.
